cli.finalMessage:
Built the scheduled payments screen at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Notes on the implementation:
- Six mock scheduled payments (payee, amount, next date, frequency), one shown pre-paused to demonstrate that state.
- Each payment row has Pause/Resume, Edit, and Cancel actions.
- Edit opens a modal form (payee, amount, date, frequency) with validation before saving.
- Cancel opens a confirmation dialog warning it can't be undone; only on confirmation is the payment removed (no undo path exists anywhere in the UI).
- "Schedule a payment" opens the same form pattern to add a new entry to the list.
- Since `node_modules` isn't installed in this folder, I couldn't safely import `@strata/react` components without risking build errors from an unverifiable API. Instead I used semantic HTML/CSS Modules built on Strata's CSS custom properties (confirmed ones like `--strata-color-surface-canvas`, `--strata-color-text-default`, `--strata-font-body`, `--strata-space-*`, plus sensibly-named ones with safe fallbacks) and logical CSS properties throughout, so theming/dark mode/RTL from `ThemeScope` should still apply correctly across brands.

I can't run the app to visually verify, so please check it renders as expected across the brand/scheme/locale combinations.
